patterns.note: A high-contrast, two-color palette of vibrant green and black dominates the entire site, used for both backgrounds and text, often in full-bleed sections.
Massive, condensed sans-serif typography is used for primary headings, often taking up full screen width or height, creating a bold, almost architectural feel.
The hero section undergoes a dramatic scroll-triggered transformation, shifting from a dark background with green text and an image to a vibrant green background with black text and a video player.
Full-bleed sections with minimal padding are used, allowing the oversized typography and vibrant colors to command attention across the entire viewport.
Large text elements scroll into view, acting as visual anchors or section dividers, with their color often contrasting sharply with the background.

technique_notes: To rebuild the hero transition, use a scroll-triggered animation library to detect scroll depth. At a certain threshold, animate the background color, text color, and swap out the hero image for a video player, while simultaneously transforming the navigation bar's color scheme.

Implement oversized, full-width text elements that scroll vertically, creating a 'text as landscape' effect. These elements should be positioned to appear as primary content blocks rather than simple headings, often with a contrasting color to the background.

Utilize a sticky navigation bar that changes its background and text color dynamically after the initial scroll, transitioning from a subtle, dark appearance to a high-contrast, vibrant green and black scheme.

design_tokens.type_scale: extremely oversized, condensed headings (5-10x body text) with smaller, clean sans-serif for body and navigation.
design_tokens.spacing: airy, with large full-bleed sections and generous vertical spacing between content blocks.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its audacious and consistent use of a single, extremely vibrant green paired with stark black, creating a high-energy, almost aggressive visual identity. This is amplified by the massive, full-screen typography and dramatic scroll-triggered color and content shifts that transform the page experience.
